props.line: Every monitor in here is still live. Nine days of watching an empty building.

props.title: Camera 7 -- Sublevel 3 approach
pages: The drive is full. It has been recording over itself for nine days. Only one clip is write-protected, timed 06:14:11.

Eleven seconds.

For four of them the corridor is empty and normal. Then the picture leans -- not shakes, leans -- as if the camera and the wall are being pulled toward the stairwell.
At second six people come into frame. Not running. Being taken off their feet, all of them going the same way, down.

At second nine one of them gets a hand to the rail and holds. For two seconds he holds.

At second eleven the clip ends and the corridor is empty again.

props.title: Door controller log
pages: Nine days of nothing. Then, scrolling back: 06:14:22 -- ALL ZONES, SIMULTANEOUS FAULT.
Every door in the building reporting at the same second. Not opened. Not forced. Fault.

And nothing after it. Not one badge, not one door, for nine days -- until 04:41 this morning, at the front entrance.

That's me.

props.title: The power chart
pages: A paper trace, still turning. Flat all night, then at 06:00 a slow climb as the shutdown ramp starts pulling.
At 06:14 the pen goes straight off the top of the paper and tears through it.
It never comes back down. Whatever the ring did, it is still doing it.
props.repeatText: The pen is still off the paper.

props.title: Things on the floor
pages: A shoe in the doorway. A pair of glasses ten feet further on, one arm bent flat.
A badge. Another shoe, the pair of the first, another twenty feet down the corridor.
They are not scattered. They are in a line, spaced out, all pointing the same way -- toward the stairwell.
props.repeatText: Still in a line. Still pointing down.

props.name: Security locker
props.lockedText: Level B lock. I don’t have that card yet.
props.openText: One key on a tag. S/W. Stairwell.
props.itemDescription: A plain brass key, tagged S/W.
props.emptyText: Spare batteries and a first aid tin.

props.lockedText: Not until I know what that recording actually shows.
